items.question: ተወዳዳሪ ሀ ከተወዳዳሪ ለ አንጻር ያለው የነጥብ ልዩነት ስንት ነው?
items.agreement_note: The unit/count noun immediately follows the numeral and never inflects for number, case, or a classifier in Amharic regardless of the integer, so it stays grammatical for any value from 1 to 999999.
items.gloss_en: Competitor X scored M points, while Competitor Y scored S points. What is Competitor X's point difference compared to Competitor Y?
items.notes: The question names Competitor X (ተወዳዳሪ ሀ), whose number is {M}.
